race.comment: Race drops right away outside the top few. CLEMENTARO (14) is a two-start maiden who improved at the second outing last time at Seymour. Bombed the start and was always well back but kept coming for fourth. Further improved and looks ideally placed out to the mile. Doesn't have to improve much to claim a maiden win. Same goes for CHALLENGING (3) who is also a two-start maiden and made inroads last time. Beaten only a couple of lengths at Bendigo and has upside out to a mile now. RIVERLEA PRINCE (7) looks the other main hope. Back for second campaign raced over a mile fresh and found Icy You far too good but finished runner-up. Fitter and despite the draw should be running on hard into the frame. ERNIE (10) gave a sight and folded up late last time but can do better off the low draw. HOT SPIRIT (11) should improve sharply over the extra ground.
